# UI Consistency Audit

A consolidation backlog synthesized from 7 dimension audits (57 raw findings, deduped and grouped). Severity reflects consistency impact, not functional risk.

## Top quick wins

High-impact, low-effort consolidations to do first:

1. **Dashboard WISHLIST status → recognisable wishlist affordance.** `StatusText` renders WISHLIST as bare yellow text, but the app already has a canonical yellow wishlist treatment (`Button variant="addWishlist"`) and a bordered yellow toggle in `PaintInfoPanelContent`. Same concept renders three ways. Render status via `<Chip accent={statusAccent[status]}>` so WISHLIST reads as a bordered yellow badge. *(src/components/kit/tags.tsx — StatusText)*
2. **Promote `STATUS_LABEL` to a shared export.** The inspector shows raw enum (BUILDING/PRIMING/PAINTING) while the collection shows spec wording (BUILT/PRIMED/PAINTED) for the *same* state. Export `STATUS_LABEL` from `StatusDropdown.tsx` and use it in the `ProjectWorkspaceBody` Listbox and `StatusText`.
3. **Fix the two sub-12px labels.** `PlannerCalendar.tsx:123` and `ArmyImportPanel.tsx:106` still use `text-[10px]`, violating the documented 12px readability floor. One-line change each to `text-[12px]`.
4. **Add one `label-osd` utility** bundling `font-osd text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.15em]` to kill the 7-way tracking sprawl (0.08–0.25em) on OSD section labels. Highest churn, single source.
5. **Route the bespoke add `+` buttons through `IconButton variant="add"`.** `ProjectsTable` rolls its own green/dashed-purple `+` against the MM-52 rule. Drop `rounded-sm` while you're there.
6. **Add a kit `CloseButton`/`RemoveButton`.** The `✕` affordance is hand-built 8 places with 2 glyphs (`✕` vs `×`) and divergent hover colours. One primitive, replace all.

---

## status / type indicators

The single biggest source of drift — the same status/type concept renders with different words, colours, and shapes across surfaces.

- **WISHLIST status as bare text** — `tags.tsx` StatusText (consumed in `ProjectsTable.tsx:177`, `ProjectWorkspaceBody.tsx:289`). Fix: render via `<Chip accent={statusAccent[status]}>` for a bordered pill matching the wishlist accent. **[high]**
- **Status wording split (enum vs spec labels)** — `ProjectWorkspaceBody.tsx:194` feeds raw `ProjectStatus` enum as labels (BUILDING/PRIMING/PAINTING/BASING/SHELVED); `StatusDropdown.tsx:26-35` maps through `STATUS_LABEL` to spec wording (BUILT/PRIMED/PAINTED/BASED/HOLD). Canonical: `STATUS_LABEL`. Fix: promote to a shared export, use it for the inspector Listbox and StatusText. **[high]**
- **Inspector status Listbox not colour-tinted** — `ProjectWorkspaceBody.tsx:190-198` has no `accent` prop, falls back to cyan. Canonical: `StatusDropdown.tsx:50` `accent={statusAccent[value]}`. Fix: pass `accent={statusAccent[project.status]}`. **[medium]**
- **Paint medium-type badge, 3 renderings** — `PaintListTable.tsx:130` (Chip purple), `CollectionTable.tsx:225` (Chip dim), `PaintInfoPanelContent.tsx:60` (plain text). Fix: add a `paintTypeAccent` map in `palette.ts` + a shared `PaintTypeChip` in `tags.tsx`; use in all three. **[medium]**
- **Stage-count chip colours diverge from statusAccent** — `CollectionStatsBar.tsx:91-97` hardcodes Painted→yellow, but `statusAccent.PAINTING` is cyan. Plus "Complete" flips purple↔green between compact (`:89`) and expanded (`:96`) modes. Canonical: `palette.ts:57-68 statusAccent`. Fix: drive every stage Stat accent from `statusAccent[<status>]`. **[medium]**

## button-likes (bespoke controls that should be kit Button/IconButton)

Same control role hand-rolled inline with drifting padding/border/accent instead of the kit variant.

- **Add `+` buttons bypass `variant="add"`** — `ProjectsTable.tsx:213-224` (green tinted outline + `rounded-sm`); `RecipePickerDialog.tsx:37` ("+ New" dashed *purple* — third off-spec accent for add). Canonical: `Button.tsx variant="add"`/`addWishlist`. Fix: use `IconButton variant="add" size="sm"`. **[high]**
- **PaintInfoPanelContent wishlist toggle** — `:114-126` bespoke `border-yellow bg-yellow/20`. Fix: `Button variant={wishlisted ? "addWishlist" : "outlineYellow"} size="sm"`. **[medium]**
- **PaintInfoPanelContent Copy / Use mini-buttons** — `:66-73`, `:161-167`, `:181-187` re-create cyan-outline secondary with varied padding. Fix: `Button variant="outlineCyan" size="sm"`. **[low]**
- **FocusPicker Remove Focus** — `:47-55` bespoke red bordered, sits next to a kit Listbox. Fix: `Button variant="danger" size="sm"`. **[low]**
- **ProjectsTable row-action icon buttons** — `:213-237` hand-rolled `h-7 w-7` squares with `rounded-sm`. Fix: `IconButton variant="add"|"outlineCyan" size="sm"`. **[medium]**
- **PaintInfoPanelContent harmony native `<select>`** — `:131-142` raw select despite UX-007 introducing kit `Listbox` to replace native selects. Fix: replace with `<Listbox>`. **[medium]**

## destructive / close (✕) actions

A recurring affordance with no shared primitive — the worst per-instance variance in the app.

- **Close-button `✕` rendered 5+ ways, 2 glyphs** — `ModalDialog.tsx:104`, `SlideOutPanel.tsx:107` (`hover:text-cyan`); `SlotRow.tsx:80`, `LayeringTool.tsx:161`, `EyedropperTool.tsx:200` (`hover:text-red`); `CollectionTable.tsx:279` (bordered red square); `InspoBoard.tsx:83`/`:137` (mixed); `CameraSampler.tsx:102` uses `×` (U+00D7) not `✕` (U+2715). Fix: add a kit `CloseButton`/`RemoveButton` (dismiss→`hover:text-cyan`, destructive→`hover:text-red`, one `✕` glyph) and replace all. **[high]**
- **Row-level delete `✕` inconsistent** — `CollectionTable.tsx:279-289` (bordered red square), `SlotRow.tsx:80-87` (borderless dim→red), `InspoBoard.tsx:83-90` (overlay px-1). Fix: standardise on `IconButton variant="outlineRed" size="sm"`. **[medium]**
- **Destructive red opacity drift** — `CollectionTable.tsx:284` (`red/50`,`hover:bg-red/15`), `DateField.tsx:156` (`red/40`,`/10`), `FocusPicker.tsx:51` (`red/50`,`/10`). Canonical: `Button.tsx variant="danger"` = `border-red bg-red/10 hover:bg-red/20`. Fix: route all through the danger variant. **[medium]**

## attach / add-item affordance

The same "attach a recipe/paint to this thing" action wears three identities.

- **Attach rendered 3 ways** — `Swatch.tsx:47-59` SwatchStrip (purple dashed `+ attach`), `ProjectWorkspaceBody.tsx:239-245` (green `Button variant="add"` `+ Paint`), `RecipeIndexTable.tsx:76-79` (`Button variant="tertiary"` link); also `AddPaintCard` (`PaintCard.tsx:24-34`, solid cyan card). Canonical: the purple-dashed SwatchStrip treatment (shared with `RecipePickerDialog.tsx:37`). Fix: pick the purple-dashed attach (wrap as a kit `AttachButton`) and apply everywhere. **[medium]**

## segmented / tab / toggle controls

- **PasteUrlBar KindToggle duplicates SegmentedToggle** — `PasteUrlBar.tsx:24-56` hand-builds a purple gapped Paint/Model control; kit `SegmentedToggle` is the documented control (its example literally names "Paint/Model") but is cyan/joined. Fix: use `<SegmentedToggle>`, adding a purple accent prop if required. **[medium]**
- **RecipePaintPicker tabs bespoke** — `RecipePaintPicker.tsx:117-138` bordered button row replicating SegmentedToggle's active-cyan look. Fix: reuse `SegmentedToggle` or factor the active/inactive class pair into one shared token. **[low]**
- **Two checkbox patterns / split accent** — `FilterPanelContent.tsx:27-39` custom `role=checkbox` box (cyan), `PaintListTable.tsx:140-150` owned switch (green), `CollectionTable` filter popover uses native `<input>` `accent-purple`. Three styles, three accents for one "labelled toggle" idea; green is the canonical "owned/positive" hue. Fix: lift `CheckRow` into a kit `Checkbox` primitive and reuse everywhere. **[low]**

## steppers / nudge / chevron glyphs

- **Three bespoke +/- steppers** — `FocusView.tsx:145-163` (`cyan/60 px-2`), `ProjectWorkspaceBody.tsx:296-330` (`cyan/40 px-1`), `PaintInfoPanelContent.tsx:88-109` (no border). Fix: extract one `Stepper` kit on `IconButton variant="outlineCyan" size="sm"`. **[medium]**
- **Nudge controls use 4 glyph families** — `SlotRow.tsx:33,37` (▲/▼), `DateField.tsx:130,138` & `PlannerCalendar.tsx` (‹/›), `ProjectWorkspaceBody.tsx:310,329` (−/+). Fix: one `StepperButton` chrome; keep glyphs semantic (chevrons=nav, −/+=value). **[low]**
- **Disclosure chevron: 3 glyphs, 2 rotations** — `ProjectsTable.tsx:154` (▸→rotate-90), `Listbox.tsx:166` (▾→rotate-180), `CollectionTable.tsx:105` (static ▾), `SlotRow.tsx:33,37` (▲/▼). Canonical: Listbox `▾`+`rotate-180`. Fix: shared `Chevron` element; make the CollectionTable filter chevron rotate on open. **[medium]**

## colour drift (tokens & opacities)

- **Hardcoded palette hex instead of token refs** — `WheelCanvas.tsx:133` (`#7DF9FF` — wrong cyan; real is `#00d2ff`), `#51FD80`; `ColorMapRail.tsx:63` (`#51fd80`,`#eef996`). Canonical: globals.css `@theme` (`--color-cyan #00d2ff`, `--color-green #51fd80`, `--color-yellow #eef996`). Fix: read from CSS custom properties / a shared TS token map; correct `#7DF9FF`→`#00d2ff`. **[medium]**
- **Active/owned green fill at 3 opacities** — `PaintListTable.tsx:148` (`green/30`), `FilterPanelContent.tsx:35` (`cyan/20` — also wrong accent), `ColourMatchTool.tsx:148` (`green/15`). Canonical: Button primary tinted fill = `/15`. Fix: standardise active/owned fills on `bg-<accent>/15`. **[medium]**
- **Split accent for "on" state** — `FilterPanelContent.tsx:35` checked=cyan vs `PaintListTable.tsx:148` owned=green. Fix: one accent per semantic (green=ownership, cyan=neutral selection). **[low]**

## panel / border drift

- **Input/field border opacity (/40 vs /50 vs /60)** — canonical `kit/Input.tsx` resting = `cyan/50`; `DateField.tsx:106` = `/60`; many inline fields (`ProjectWorkspaceBody.tsx:414`, `RecipeEditorView.tsx:166`, `SlotRow.tsx:68,75`) = `/40`. Fix: route text inputs through `kit/Input` or fix to `cyan/50`; align DateField `/60`→`/50`. **[medium]**
- **Inner-cell frame opacity (/20–/50)** — `ProjectWorkspaceBody.tsx:78,180` (/20), `SlotRow.tsx:30`/`CollectionTable.tsx:31` (/30), `PaintCard.tsx:8,29`/`InspoBoard.tsx:56` (/40), tools input frames (/50). Canonical: StatBox inner-cell = `/40`. Fix: pick one faint-frame alpha (e.g. `cyan/30`) or add a `border-faint` utility. **[low]**
- **Table header / divider rule (/20 vs /30 vs /40)** — table headers mostly `cyan/30`, section dividers `cyan/20` (`DashboardView.tsx:112`, `CollectionTable.tsx:300`), panel/modal headers `cyan/40` (`ModalDialog.tsx:93`, `SlideOutPanel.tsx:96`). Fix: define two tiers — table/inline=`cyan/30`, panel chrome=`cyan/40` — as utilities. **[low]**
- **Raised-surface bg (/40 vs /30)** — `bg-bg-raised/40` (`UpcomingEventsBar.tsx:18`, `CollectionTable.tsx:31`, `MobileTopBar.tsx:14`, `ThemeStudio.tsx:386,395`) vs `/30` (`InspoBoard.tsx:56`, `ProjectsTable.tsx:245`). Fix: standardise on `bg-bg-raised/40`. **[low]**
- **Panel padding (p-3/4/5/6/8)** — implicit norm is `p-4` (dashboard/focus/recipe editor); tools hub uses `p-6`, tools panels `p-5`, settings/account `p-5`, public `p-8`. Fix: standardise content-Panel padding to `p-4` (or add a `padding` prop with a fixed scale); reserve larger padding for marketing panels. **[low]**

## surface depth, radius & focus

- **Rounded corners violate hard-edge language** — `ProjectsTable.tsx:152,221,234` & `MiniCalendar.tsx:157` use `rounded-sm`; the system is square (`--radius-panel: 2px`, StatusIcon "no rounded SaaS icons"). Fix: drop `rounded-sm` or use `borderRadius: var(--radius-panel)`. **[low]**
- **Bespoke buttons suppress the 2px cyan focus ring** — `ProjectsTable.tsx:152,221,234`, `DateField.tsx:128,136,156`, `MiniCalendar.tsx:157`, `FocusPicker.tsx:51` set `focus:outline-none` + faint bg tint instead of the global `:focus-visible` 2px cyan outline (WCAG 2.2). Fix: drop `focus:outline-none` / add `focus-visible:outline-2`. **[medium]**
- **Focus PaintCard/AddPaintCard lack panel-depth + radius** — `PaintCard.tsx:8,29` flat `border-cyan/40`, no `panel-depth`/`radius-panel`, read flatter than every Panel/StatBox. Fix: add `panel-depth` + `borderRadius: var(--radius-panel)`. **[medium]**
- **ProjectWorkspaceBody meta/stat cells duplicate StatBox** — `:78,180,186,200,219` hand-rolled `border-cyan/20`, no depth/radius, ad-hoc padding. Fix: replace with `StatBox accent="cyan"`. **[medium]**

## duplicated components

Whole components/surfaces reimplemented instead of composed.

- **ModalDialog ≈ SlideOutPanel (~95% same)** — identical focus-trap (incl. the MM-24 comment), backdrop, header (breadcrumb + cyan title + ✕), footer; differ only in positioning + body scroll. Fix: extract `useFocusTrap(open,onClose)` hook + a shared backdrop/header/footer chrome; vary by `variant="center"|"side"`. **[medium]**
- **Two hand-rolled modal surfaces bypass ModalDialog** — `CameraSampler.tsx:99` (solid `border-cyan` `p-3`), `InspoBoard.tsx:135` (`border-cyan/60` `p-2` one-off glow). Canonical: `kit/ModalDialog.tsx`. Fix: render both inside ModalDialog. **[medium]**
- **PaintCard duplicates RecipePaintTile** — both render swatch-coloured brand/name/layer cards with `readableText(hex)`; `PaintCard.tsx` is a bespoke fixed-size reimplementation of the kit `RecipePaintTile`. Fix: replace PaintCard/AddPaintCard with `RecipePaintTile` (+ an "add" variant). **[medium]**
- **Two recipe-picker dialogs duplicate row markup** — `RecipePickerDialog.tsx` & `AssignToRecipeDialog.tsx` repeat the same recipe-row button class string + "+ New" + empty-state. Fix: extract a shared `RecipePickRow` + one "new recipe" affordance. **[medium]**
- **Table chrome re-implemented per table** — `CollectionTable`, `ProjectsTable`, `RecipeIndexTable`, `PaintListTable` (ARIA-grid) each repeat the same thead/header-cell/zebra/empty-cell class strings. Fix: add a kit `Table`/`TableHeader`/`TableRow` (or exported header/row class tokens). **[medium]**
- **Filter popover duplicated as ad-hoc panel** — `CollectionTable.tsx:107-142` bespoke absolute panel with no outside-click/ESC, vs `Listbox.tsx:179`/`DateField.tsx:116` which solve it (purple border here, cyan/60 elsewhere; different shadow tokens). Fix: extract a kit `Popover` (outside-click/ESC + panel-depth) and rebuild the filter on it. **[low]**
- **Standalone Swatch reimplemented inline** — `SwatchWall.tsx:98-112` (`border-black/40`), `PaintInfoPanelContent.tsx:44-49` (`border-fg/20`), `PaintCard` (inline bg) — three borders for one swatch surface vs canonical `kit/Swatch.tsx` (`border-fg/20`). Fix: standardise on `Swatch`. **[low]**
- **Bespoke empty-table states bypass EmptyState** — `PaintListTable.tsx:49-58`, `SwatchWall.tsx:54-67` hand-build "No paints match" blocks; `EmptyState` is the documented one and is used by Collection/Projects/RecipeIndex tables. Fix: replace both with `<EmptyState>`. **[low]**

## badges / chips

- **SectionLabel is a filled green pill, not a Chip** — `FilterPanelContent.tsx:7-13` reuses Chip's exact typography (font-osd, 12px, uppercase tracking) but adds a `bg-green/20` fill Chip never uses (Chip is border-only). Fix: use `<Chip accent="green">` or promote a documented "filled" Chip variant / kit `SectionLabel`. **[low]**

## typography

- **OSD-label tracking sprawls across 7 values** — canonical `tags.tsx` Chip/StatusText/PriorityTag = `tracking-[0.15em]`; consumers drift to 0.08 (`RecipePaintTile.tsx:44`), 0.12 (`ProjectWorkspaceBody.tsx:269`), 0.16 (`CollectionStatsBar.tsx:32`), 0.18 (`StatBox.tsx:38`, `Input.tsx:29`), 0.2 (`Panel.tsx:49`), 0.25 (`error.tsx:7`, `not-found.tsx:8`). Fix: add a `label-osd` `@utility` (`font-osd text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.15em]`) and replace the ad-hoc strings. **[high]**
- **Sub-12px labels violate readability floor** — `PlannerCalendar.tsx:123`, `ArmyImportPanel.tsx:106` use `text-[10px]` against the documented 12px floor. Fix: change both to `text-[12px]`. **[high]**
- **Error/not-found eyebrow one-off 0.25em** — `error.tsx:7`, `not-found.tsx:8`. Fix: drop to canonical `0.15em` (subsumed by `label-osd` above). **[low]**
- **text-sm OSD heading tracking split** — `LandingView.tsx:69` uses `0.15em` vs the norm `0.18em` (`ModalDialog.tsx:100`, `SlideOutPanel.tsx:103`, `ToolsHubView.tsx:43`, `NavLinks.tsx:31`, `EmptyState.tsx:34`). Fix: change LandingView to `tracking-[0.18em]`. **[low]**
- **Uppercase metadata label in font-mono not font-osd** — `LegalDoc.tsx:23,129` ("Last updated …") uses `font-mono` for an uppercase tracked label that is the OSD-header role everywhere else. Fix: swap `font-mono`→`font-osd`. **[medium]**
- **Input rendered in font-display** — `ArmyImportPanel.tsx:115` sets `font-display` on a text input; globals.css forces form controls onto body `font-mono`. Fix: replace with `font-mono`. **[medium]**
- **Pinned-project title bespoke vs PageHeader scale** — `FocusView.tsx:100` (`font-display text-lg uppercase`) vs `ProjectWorkspaceBody.tsx:174` (`font-display text-2xl`, not uppercase) for the same hero title. Canonical: `PageHeader.tsx` (`font-display text-2xl … sm:text-3xl`, no forced uppercase). Fix: align both on one size + casing. **[low]**

## interaction-affordance mismatch

- **Tables imply clickability they don't have** — all of `RecipeIndexTable.tsx:58-62`, `CollectionTable.tsx:190-198`, `PaintListTable.tsx:87-113` apply `hover:bg-cyan/5`, but only RecipeIndexTable makes the whole row clickable (+`cursor-pointer`). Canonical: RecipeIndexTable's row-clickable + inner `stopPropagation` (MM-28). Fix: either make the other two rows fully clickable, or drop the hover highlight on non-clickable rows. **[medium]**

## overview / KPI bars

- **Equivalent KPI bars render with and without panel surface** — `CollectionStatsBar.tsx:74` (borderless sticky strip, `bg-bg/90`, `cyan/30` top rule) vs `UpcomingEventsBar.tsx:18` (`bg-bg-raised/40`, `cyan/40`) vs dashboard StatRow (framed StatBoxes). The two strips disagree on bg token + border alpha. Canonical: StatBox/StatRow for metrics; UpcomingEventsBar's `bg-bg-raised/40`+`cyan/40` for docked bars. Fix: align the two docked bars on one bg + border alpha; box metrics or keep flat consistently. **[low]**
